posts.author: Caz
posts.body:
You can use them for that but it probably doesn't look very good because the carpet underneath it doesn't make any sense. If it was one big piece of carpet it would run up the sides. and the piece on top of the incline would be vertically offset by a few pixels like this rough example:
This is something you'd need to make custom tiles for though, so it might be better to just keep the carpet separated from the elevated section.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
isaac3000 said:
Aren't these supposed to make elevated terain? Unless I am using it wrong, it doesn't look good...
Click to expand...
all autotiles  tiles are basically made to look good on large areas only. using them with one tile width rarely looks good.
that said, the map has only one level and no true elevation/z-height.
tiles like those are made to give the illusion of elevation, but they are also intended to do that only if the entire inside is filled with that specific tile - that is simply how the autotiles work.
ir might look better if you learn to use shift-click mapping as that would allow you to selectively disable the autotile change - there are tutorials for this on the forum, please search for them (I don't have a link). Shift-klick mapping has been unchanged since VXA...
